sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Ash Crowned Mantis Warlord from reference, chalk grey layered chitin over charcoal slender body, jagged ash crown, amber eye, two curved forearm blades, faded crimson sash and trailing red cape strips. Exactly 6x6 grid of 36 separate sprites. Each whole figure only 70% of cell width, transparent gutters all sides large enough for extended blade, no overlap. Reading row-major: row1 first4 idle breathing, last2 begin eight-step walk; row2 remaining six walk frames alternating leg contacts and passing; row3 first4 four windup lifts paired blades up and back, last2 begin forward slash; row4 first4 remaining slash/followthrough, last2 begin recovery; row5 first4 finish recovery easing blades to guard, last2 start hurt recoil; row6 first2 finish hurt then last4 progressive death standing stagger, kneel, falling, collapsed. Ensure all four death poses distinct, never merely shrink character. Face right, same proportions, real joint bending and weapon angles. COMPLETE blades entirely within their own cells. Transparent empty background.

qa.review: Source sheets visually reviewed; independent complete alpha components explicitly selected; merged characters and edge-clipped poses excluded. Source atlas and attacks unchanged.
qa.mechanical_packaging: Component isolation of authored source pixels, scale normalization and atlas packing; no procedural animation or interpolation.

combat_motion_v7.calibration: Continuous endpoint height and rig median; uniform sheet palette match; source pixels never morphed or interpolated.
